thread:
jordan.sales: Hey team — prepping a POC kickoff with FinBank. They insist on BYOK backed by HSM attestation, automated rotation windows (daily/weekly options), and proof of zero-key-exposure. Need ops + security + pricing to confirm timelines & cost. Can we align?

alex.k: Got it. Do they want full CMK import (wrapped key material) or just key-wrapping via our proxy to their KMS? That affects the ops work and pricing.

maria.s: From security side: FinBank asked for FIPS 140-2/3 attestation, HSM vendor attestation (AWS CloudHSM or Cust HSM), dual-control key ceremony options, and audit trail retention 7 yrs. Also need KMS API spec for our attestation doc.

devon.ops: Important ops note — if we do per-request unwrap/rewrap with customer HSM, expect added tail latency ~30-60ms per token depending on region. Also egress to customer VPC for key ops will add networking cost. We should propose a cached wrapped-key TTL to balance latency vs exposure.

jordan.sales: They specifically mentioned they can't accept storing plaintext keys on our nodes at any time. So any caching has to keep keys wrapped/unwrapped in HSM KVM only. Is that feasible?

alex.k: Yes — architecture: customer imports master key into their HSM and we perform WrapKey/Unwrap via a short-lived ephemeral CEK for model inference. Key material never lands as plaintext on our instances. We'll provide a small shim that invokes PKCS#11 endpoint in the customer's VPC.

maria.s: Needs a short runbook for the key ceremony (steps, roles, evidence). Also: will provide a template answer for their security questionnaire (they sent a long one). I can draft next-day.

devon.ops: Ops runbook items I need from them: network CIDR for HSM endpoints, egress ports, TLS cert chain, expected qps for wrap/unwrap (sample workload), and a test vector to validate integrity. If they give us 50 qps, we should size for headroom and maybe recommend Dedicated slot pricing.

jordan.sales: Pricing ask — they want (1) rough POC estimate for 2 weeks, (2) monthly cost at 50qps vs 500qps, (3) any uplift for HSM attestation support and on-call 24/7. Can someone draft numbers?

alex.k: Quick back-of-envelope: POC (2w): $4k setup (networking, sprint), $2k infra (reserved tiny GPU hours + proxy). Monthly @50qps: SaaS usage ~$6k + HSM tunnel ops $1.5k. Monthly @500qps: SaaS usage ~$35k + HSM ops $6k. HSM attestation & compliance package add-on: one-time $8k + $1k/mo for artifact retention and audit support. These are placeholders — billing wants final quote after we lock model tapering and exact egress.

security-bot: Reminder: attach latest "HSM-attestation-template-v2.pdf" and "BYOK-runbook-sample.md" to the thread for presales.

maria.s: I'll take the questionnaire. Also confirm: do we need KMS rotation window to be customer-triggered or scheduled by us? FinBank asked for daily rotation option with manual override and activity notifications to their SOC. We should propose both.

devon.ops: Technical ask: we need a sample curl for the wrap call to give to their infra team. Example:

curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/wrap \ \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"key_id":"/customer/kek","plaintext_ce":"<base64>","ttl_secs":300}'

Response includes wrapped_ce, wrap_metadata.

jordan.sales: Great. Next steps: Maria + Devon to draft runbook + test vectors by EOD Thursday; Alex to refine pricing and send a short quote; I'll schedule a 30min sync with FinBank on Friday at 10am PT. Anyone object to Fri 10am?

alex.k: Fine for me.

maria.s: Fine — I'll attach the questionnaire draft before the call.

devon.ops: Works. I'll also produce a minimal stress-test script and a staging IP allowlist for their infra team.

jordan.sales: Awesome — flagging blockers: legal asked if BYOK escrow is allowed (customer said no), and finance needs proration rules for mid-month Dedicated upgrades. I'll loop in legal/finance after our doc set is ready. :thumbsup:
